title: High Society
venue_description:
High Society Restaurant and Bar

High Society is Murfreesboro's premiere upscale bar and grill located in the heart of downtown on Main Street. This locally and family-owned establishment opened in May 2025 and has quickly become the epicenter of live music and nightlife in Murfreesboro. The restaurant specializes in Cajun-Asian fusion cuisine blending Louisiana Cajun flavors with Asian cooking techniques featuring signature items like Cajun shrimp boils and Vietnamese pho with Cajun-style broths.

Music and Entertainment

High Society is known for its vibrant entertainment programming. Wednesday nights feature the beloved Jam Sessions that have become a community institution. Musicians of all skill levels gather to perform blues country rock R&B and various other genres. The lounge features live music performances from featured artists and a rotating roster of talented local musicians. Karaoke nights and stand-up comedy events round out the entertainment offerings.

Venue Experience

The space is thoughtfully designed with an upscale yet welcoming atmosphere. High Society functions as both a restaurant and entertainment venue with a full bar featuring specialty drinks fine wines and local brews. The venue is versatile and regularly hosts private events celebrations and corporate gatherings. A VIP lounge offers exclusive seating bottle service and an elevated atmosphere for those seeking a more luxurious experience.

Hours and Accessibility

Open Monday-Wednesday 3pm-12am Thursday 3pm-3am Friday 3pm-3am and Saturday 11am-3am. Closed Sundays except by appointment. Located at 211 W Main Street in historic downtown Murfreesboro making it easily accessible and walkable from surrounding businesses and attractions.
